mapper.sql: a.id AS id, a.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, a.title AS title, a.tier AS tier, p.price AS originalPrice, a.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, a.total_stock AS totalStock, a.total_stock AS stock, CASE a.status WHEN 0 THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN 2 THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status, a.status AS statusCode, a.start_at AS startAt, a.end_at AS endAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT id, product_id, title, tier, seckill_price, total_stock, start_at, end_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_seckill_activity WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_seckill_activity SET total_stock = total_stock - 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND total_stock > 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE a.status IN (0, 1) AND a.start_at <= #{before} AND a.end_at > #{now} ORDER BY a.start_at ASC, a.id ASC
SELECT FROM t_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE a.tier IN (2, 3) AND a.start_at <= #{now} AND a.end_at >= #{after} ORDER BY a.id ASC
